label: A
description: A: alluvium and low terraces; flood plains, fans, deltas - mainly sand, gravel and silt (GSC OF 48, Klassen 1971, Franklin Bay 97C and Brock River 97D, 1:250 000)

label: Cx
description: Cx: colluvial complex: colluvium, bedrock, talus, slope deposits (GSC OF 48, Klassen 1971)

label: E
description: E: eolian: dunes, mainly sand (GSC OF 48, Klassen 1971)

label: L
description: L: lacustrine deposits, extensive organic deposits, areas of thermokarst lakes, generally underlain by silt, sand and clay or peat (GSC OF 48, Klassen 1971)

label: To
description: To: high terraces and outwash trains; dominantly sand and gravel (GSC OF 48, Klassen 1971)

label: Tk
description: Tk: kettled terraces and outwash trains; dominantly sand and gravel (GSC OF 48, Klassen 1971)

label: Mt
description: Mt: hummocky terrain; mainly till but locally and in part gravel (GSC OF 48, Klassen 1971)

label: Mx
description: Mx: moraine complex; transverse ridges and hummocks, mainly till but in part and locally gravel (GSC OF 48, Klassen 1971)

label: M
description: M: moraine unit, subscript not legible on the scan (Mt hummocky terrain or Mx moraine complex: mainly till, locally gravel) (GSC OF 48, Klassen 1971)

label: R
description: R: areas of thin and patchy drift, rock outcrop and soliflucted uplands (GSC OF 48, Klassen 1971); coded till first (thin drift is named first; on 97D the newer CGM 112 maps 72 % of these areas as till Tb/Th/Tv and 17 % as bedrock)

label: UD
description: No unit symbol: legend NOTE, areas not designated as one of the units comprise undifferentiated drift or thin undifferentiated drift on rock (GSC OF 48, Klassen 1971): drift (till-dominated) or thin drift on rock, undivided
